findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_live, check_freshness · Private data: check_freshness, reconcile · Public sink: reconcile · Destructive: acceptance_gate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_live, check_freshness · Private data: check_freshness, reconcile · Public sink: reconcile · Destructive: acceptance_gate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
